You are a mathematics expert solving competition-level problems. 
Solve the problem step by step, showing your work clearly.
At the end, provide your final answer in the format:
Answer: <your_answer>

Where <your_answer> is the numerical or mathematical answer to the problem.

How many hours will it take Matthew to dig the specified number of small and large holes? It takes Matthew 3 minutes to dig one small hole for shrubs. It takes Matthew 10 minutes to dig one large hole for trees. Matthew needs to dig 30 small holes. Matthew needs to dig 15 large holes. Matthew works continuously for two hours during the work period. Matthew takes 5 minutes to dig one medium hole. Matthew needs to dig 10 medium holes. One hour contains 60 minutes.
